in_hebrew.name: מרכל
in_hebrew.long_meaning: The name 'Marchall' in Hebrew is derived from the root words 'marach' meaning warrior and 'el' meaning God. It can be translated as 'little warrior of God'.

in_greek.name: Μαρχαλλιος
in_greek.long_meaning: The name 'Marchall' in Greek is derived from the word 'Marchallios' which means 'warrior of God'. It is a compound name, combining the elements 'March' (war) and 'allos' (other, God).

in_latin.name: Marchallus
in_latin.long_meaning: The name 'Marchall' in Latin is derived from the elements 'March' (war) and 'allus' (God's). It can be translated as 'March, God's warrior'.
